Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd prefer to keep my name off the recording for now, but I'm happy to answer your questions.
Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where you were when the collision happened?
A: I was in Conroe, Texas, on the main road heading toward the shopping center. I was changing lanes to get into the
right lane because my turn was coming up.
Q: What were the weather and road conditions like?
A: It was clear and dry. Traffic was moderate, nothing unusual for that stretch.
Q: Walk me through what happened as you moved over.
A: I checked my mirror, saw the lane looked open, and signaled. I started to move over slowly. Then I felt a bump on
my side and heard scraping. The other car had come up alongside me in the lane I was entering.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before you began your lane change?
A: Not directly. I looked in the mirror and didn't see anything close, but I may not have checked my blind spot as
thoroughly as I should have.
Q: Did you stop or pull over after the contact?
A: Yes, I pulled onto the shoulder a short distance away. Both cars were still drivable, so we moved them out of the
traffic flow.
Q: Were you injured?
A: Yes. My neck and lower back started hurting within an hour or so. It's a stiff, aching pain, and turning my head is
uncomfortable.
Q: Have you sought medical care?
A: I went to a clinic the same day and was told I had strains in my neck and back. I've been doing home exercises
and taking over-the-counter pain relievers.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?
A: Only that I want to cooperate fully and get my car repaired. Thank you for your time.
Q: Thank you. This cocnludes the statement.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page

- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,

- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any

- "reason": one short sentence.
